# hUGEDriver

Vendored from [SuperDisk/hUGEDriver v6.1.3](https://github.com/SuperDisk/hUGEDriver/releases/tag/v6.1.3).

Contents:

- `gbdk/hUGEDriver.lib` is the GBDK library from the release archive.
- `include/hUGEDriver.h` and `rgbds/hUGEDriver.asm` are the matching upstream sources.

hUGEDriver is dedicated to the public domain by its authors. See the upstream [README](https://github.com/SuperDisk/hUGEDriver/blob/v6.1.3/README.md).
